title: a crossing's commit never holds codemother's lock
intention: Clearance's queueme hands the crossing to the gate's own worker and returns at once, and the worker replies to the asker by reply_to when the crossing (and its records' commit) is done, so every other codemother ask is answered while a crossing's commit and its pre-commit reseal run.
why: Measured 2026-11-24 on akiendelllinux: b03dce633aa8's PROVEME queueme ran ticket.passed inline, and commit_crossing_records' git commit (pid 84628) ran 7m56s and counting under the pre-commit reseal (pid 84674, cairn.devices.tester.cli --reseal --stage). Meanwhile the asker's reach timed out at 120 s and a hollow's resolves_to ask to codemother timed out at 300 s ('no reply to envelope 8b20ec6c… from codemother within 300.0s'). e4714e460e32 took chart and verdict stages off the shim lock; clearance was not among them.
traces_to: Law 7 — the starvation is loud only because 11d79defab3b made it so; CP1 — a gate that cannot answer while it is busy elsewhere answers nobody.
how: Copy chart_gate's per-stage FIFO worker (_WORKERS, reply_to) into the clearance gate: queueme validates the fileref and answers queued at once; one worker drains the FIFO, running today's body unchanged and posting the dict it returns today to the asker by reply_to. A red-first proof drives a crossing whose records sit in a scratch git repo with a sleeping pre-commit hook.

clauses.claim: while a crossing's commit takes 30 s (a scratch repo whose pre-commit hook sleeps), a second ask to the clearance device is answered within 5 s
the queueme asker receives the crossing's answer (the workflow, or the refusal) by reply_to once the commit lands, the same dict queueme returns today
two queuemes for one ticket cross in the order sent, the second starting only after the first's commit lands

decisions.text: D1: the clearance gate's queueme validates the fileref, enqueues the envelope on the gate's one FIFO, and answers {accepted: true, queued: true, ticket}; one worker per process runs today's body and posts its answer by reply_to, as chart_gate does (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/gate.py lines 38-77).
D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause, drives the gate in-process over a scratch commons and a scratch git repo whose pre-commit hook sleeps 30 s.

out: the pre-commit reseal and its budget

measured.saw: clearance did not answer b03dce633aa8 within 120s; ps showed pid 84628 `git -C .../outline_check commit -q -m crossing records: b03dce633aa8 passed into PROVEME` at 07:56 elapsed with child 84674 `cairn.devices.tester.cli --reseal --stage`; a concurrent `cairn test --hollow` failed 'inspect resolves_to refused: no reply ... from codemother within 300.0s'; the crossing landed once the commit finished (83c80dbeb)
measured.how: sail.py cross b03dce633aa8; ps -p 84628 -o pid,etime,args; bin/cairn test --hollow b03dce633aa8 --seal
